page.layout: One column of running text on the left page, with handwritten annotations in the right margin of the column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. No footer.

main_text.p: Adhuc earum controuersiarum tractationem expofui-mus, quę exiuris æquitatisq; concertatione nascuntur. Deinceps earum exempla pro-feremus, quæ ex iuris scripti & non scripti comparatio-ne promanant: quarum copia in libris nostris uel maxima reperitur. Cum enim ex argumentatione constet hæc tractatio, nullus apud Dialecticos locus est argu-mentandi, cuius hoc in genere usus non fit. Exem-pla autem quia in promptu cuiuis esse possunt, ea tantum quorum commemora-tio

page.notes: The handwritten marks in the right margin beside the column (Greek-like scribbles and a few small strokes) are manuscript annotations, not printed text, so they are left out. The running head is set in spaced capitals with ornamental letters; read as IVRISCONSVLTVS and normalised to IURISCONSULTUS. The word "commemora-tio" continues from the line above across the column end. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
